```{r Load packages}
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(tidyr)
library(readxl)
# TODO: add statistical model (currently descriptive only)
# library(glmmTMB)   # For beta regression
# library(lme4)
# library(emmeans)
```

```{r Load data}
# NOTE: FDiv_GroundCover_2025.xlsx is not yet in the repo — add it for reproducibility
# Data available for 3 sites: FCEA, FAB, LLFS (no GAM)
ground_cover_CAN <- read_excel("FDiv_GroundCover_2025.xlsx")
ground_cover_LLFS <- read_excel("FDiv_GroundCover_2025.xlsx", sheet = "LLFS Ground cover 2024")
ground_cover_AB <- read_excel("FDiv_GroundCover_2025.xlsx", sheet = "AB Ground cover 2025")

ground_cover_LLFS <- ground_cover_LLFS[, -5]
ground_cover_CAN <- ground_cover_CAN[, -5]
ground_cover_AB <- ground_cover_AB[, -5]

ground_cover <- bind_rows(ground_cover_AB, ground_cover_CAN, ground_cover_LLFS) %>%
  filter(!is.na(Treatment))
```

```{r Calculate percentages}
ground_cover_pct <- ground_cover %>%
  mutate(across(where(is.numeric), ~ replace_na(.x, 0))) %>%
  mutate(
    denom = `Total cover` - `Planted tree` - `Natural woody vegetation` - Moss,
    Bare_soil_pct = `Bare soil` / denom * 100,
    Leaf_litter_pct = `Leaf litter` / denom * 100,
    Forb_pct = Forb / denom * 100,
    Grass_pct = Grass / denom * 100
  )

ground_cover_avg <- ground_cover_pct %>%
  group_by(Site, Treatment) %>%
  summarise(
    Bare_soil_pct = mean(Bare_soil_pct, na.rm = TRUE),
    Leaf_litter_pct = mean(Leaf_litter_pct, na.rm = TRUE),
    Forb_pct = mean(Forb_pct, na.rm = TRUE),
    Grass_pct = mean(Grass_pct, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = c(Bare_soil_pct, Leaf_litter_pct, Forb_pct, Grass_pct),
    names_to = "Cover_Type",
    values_to = "Percentage"
  )

# Standardize treatment and site names
ground_cover_avg <- ground_cover_avg %>%
  mutate(
    Treatment = gsub("Sp12", "12SP", Treatment),
    Treatment = gsub("Sp2", "2SP", Treatment),
    Treatment = gsub("Sp6", "6SP", Treatment),
    Site = gsub("CAN", "FCEA", Site),
    Site = gsub("AB", "FAB", Site),
    Treatment = factor(Treatment, levels = c("C", "M1", "M2", "2SP", "6SP", "12SP"))
  )
```

```{r Plot ground cover}
Ground_cover <- ggplot(ground_cover_avg, aes(x = Treatment, y = Percentage, fill = Cover_Type)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", position = "stack") +
  facet_wrap(~ Site) +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = c("Bare_soil_pct" = "saddlebrown", "Leaf_litter_pct" = "darkgoldenrod2",
               "Forb_pct" = "olivedrab", "Grass_pct" = "darkolivegreen1"),
    labels = c("Bare_soil_pct" = "Bare Soil", "Leaf_litter_pct" = "Leaf Litter",
               "Forb_pct" = "Forb", "Grass_pct" = "Grass")
  ) +
  labs(x = "Treatment", y = "Percentage", fill = "Cover Type") +
  theme_minimal()

ggsave("Ground_cover_2025.jpeg", plot = Ground_cover, width = 8, height = 5, dpi = 300)
```
